links.outcome: Demographic disparities (DPD, DEOdds) and diagnostic performance after fairness-aware pretraining for glaucoma detection
links.effect: FairEnc reduced demographic disparities measured by DPD and DEOdds while keeping strong diagnostic performance in zero-shot and linear probing; on FairFundus, performance stayed within a competitive range.
links.quote: Comprehensive experiments on the publicly available Harvard-FairVLMed dataset show that FairEnc reduces demographic disparities measured by DPD and DEOdds while achieving strong diagnostic performance under both zero-shot and linear probing evaluations.

unlisted_practices: Fair pretraining of vision-language models with mutual information regularization and multi-discriminator adversarial debiasing
LLM-generated synthetic clinical descriptions with varied sensitive attributes and contrastive alignment for demographic-invariant text encoders

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a new multimodal vision-language pretraining technique (FairEnc) designed to reduce demographic bias in glaucoma detection using benchmark datasets.
